INTRO_STORY:
I am the healer. Listen to the story of Kimeria.

In the days of King Rufardus the Wise, the witch L'Kardina came to our kingdom. She had been banished from a neighboring land. When Kimeria tried to drive her away as well, her fury became a terrible curse.

The sun ceased to shine. Darkness swallowed the kingdom, and eternal night settled over its sleeping lands.

Word of Kimeria's misfortune reached a wandering warrior named Edgard. He set out on a long journey to overthrow the witch and save the kingdom.

On his way, he met me, an old healer. Beyond our meeting lay unfamiliar paths and cunning traps. I gave him my counsel, and he ventured onward.

Here begins Edgard's journey through the sleeping kingdom.
ENDING_STORY:
Edgard has defeated every enemy.

The kingdom is free of monsters.

Light has returned to the world.

THE END
HEALER_GREETING: Edgard, the forest guardian bars your path. I can brew an elixir to strengthen your sword against him.
EDGARD_REPLY: What do you need for the elixir?
HEALER_INGREDIENTS: The recipe needs Chicken and Key. You are missing ingredients. Check the list; payment also needs every coin from this forest.
HEALER_PAYMENT: You have the ingredients, but not enough payment. Bring every coin from this forest; coins from earlier lands do not count.
HEALER_BOTH: You are missing ingredients and payment. Bring Chicken, Key and every coin from this forest. The list shows what is still missing.
HEALER_READY: I see you have everything: Chicken, Key and all forest coins. I'll brew your elixir now. Drink it, and your sword will strike this boss ten times harder.
HEALER_OFFER: I can send you to the forest entrance to collect what you missed. Or face him without the elixir. Once the fight begins, there is no way back.
HEALER_PAID: Chicken, Key and all forest coins are paid. You drink the elixir. Your sword now deals tenfold damage to this boss alone.
HEALER_LOCK: Defeat him to open the way onward. The elixir lasts through this battle and its retries, then ends with his defeat.
HEALER_VICTORY: The forest guardian is defeated, Edgard. You have opened the way ahead.
EDGARD_DARKNESS: But darkness still hangs over the kingdom.
HEALER_GUIDE: Your journey continues. I will be your guide. Go on: we will meet again.
ABOUT_RULES: One hit kills; attempts are unlimited. Retry from this room; new pickups roll back, secured ones stay kept. Tap jump for each jump. Assist extends trap warnings.
